messages:
Rhea (ENG Manager): heads up  planning to move Devika RWI-2233 from Senior IC -> Eng Manager effective 2026-08-10. Need owners for comp change, HRIS, payroll proration, and benefits enrollment. who should I loop?
Sofia (People Ops): congrats! :tada: People Ops owns comp-change intake + benefits enrollment; Hiring Ops owns HRIS/title/headcount; Payroll handles proration & retro. If equity adjustments needed, loop Grants and Finance.
Rhea (ENG Manager): Devika's refresh is due 2026-09-01 and bonus cutoff was 2026-03-31. Will manager change affect either?
Sofia (People Ops): refresh schedule stays the same unless you request an amendment on the comp form. Bonus cycle closed 3/31 so no retro impact for that cycle.
Ivy (Hiring Ops): I'll open HRIS ticket HRIS-5428 to update title + manager field and set effective_date=2026-08-10. If headcount unchanged, no new req needed. ETA EOD tomorrow for the update.
Marcus (Payroll): payroll cycles are 1st & 15th. For an 8/10 effective date: to include proration in the 8/1-15 pay, approvals + HRIS change must be completed by 2026-07-29 17:00 PT. Otherwise proration and any retro will land in the next cycle.
Rhea (ENG Manager): what's the proration method? calendar days?
Marcus (Payroll): yes, calendar days. Example: 8/10 effective with timely approval -> payroll will pay prorated base for 8/1-15 (10 days at new base). Late approvals = retro in next cycle.
Devika (IC -> Manager): thanks! Do I need to re-enroll dependents for manager perks or will existing elections carry?
Sofia (People Ops): dependents stay. Manager perks (leadership stipend, coaching allowance) are available during a 30-day special enrollment window from your effective date (so until 2026-09-09). If you change medical plans, you may need to reconfirm dependent info. We'll DM steps.
Onboard Bot: reminder queued: submit comp-change form: https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/comp-change. Approval chain: manager -> director -> finance -> people-ops.
Rhea (ENG Manager): I'll submit comp-change today. Any fields to be careful about?
Sofia (People Ops): ensure new_base, new_band, effective_date, PRORATE_FLAG, and attach job spec + short justification. If you want an equity amendment, tick the box and include target grant notes. Grants team needs ~2 weeks post-approval for amendments.
Rhea (ENG Manager): submitted form and attached spec.
Sofia (People Ops): received and routing for approvals now. Adding Payroll and Hiring Ops to the approval thread.
Marcus (Payroll): I see the comp-change and HRIS ticket pending. Will queue payroll actions once approvals complete. Reminder: all cutoff times are PT.
Ivy (Hiring Ops): HRIS ticket created and linked. Will post when changes sync to internal systems (Slack display + org chart usually within 24 hrs after HRIS patch).
Devika (IC -> Manager): appreciate the clarity. One last Q: if approvals slip past cutoff, how soon does retro hit?
Marcus (Payroll): retro is paid in the next available pay cycle after approvals. We'll post estimated retro amount once approvals finalize; you can also request a manual estimate from payroll.
Rhea (ENG Manager): thanks all 49b closing after payroll confirmation.
Marcus (Payroll): will post when retro scheduled. :white_check_mark:
